title: One-step simulation outside the query state
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic oracle Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $O$ be a Boolean oracle language, and let $c$ be a configuration on Boolean input $x$ with state $q$, where $q$ is not the query state of $N$. Suppose an added tape with content $T$ and head position $p$ has scanned symbol $b$. One step of the constructed deterministic oracle machine from the configuration obtained by adding this tape to $c$ yields the configuration obtained by taking the step of $N$ on $c$ using choice bit $b$ and adding the same tape with its head at $p+1$.
